name: tilnote-blog
description: Tilnote Blog - write with AI, publish to your Tilnote blog, share it, follow news on your topics, make a book, and find the next post

plugins.name: tilnote-blog
plugins.description: Write blog posts together with AI and publish them to your Tilnote blog. Look a topic up and write it in your own words, upgrade posts you already have - polished in your voice, brought up to date, easier to find - turn a post into Threads, X, LinkedIn and KakaoTalk versions, keep the news topics you follow in Tilnote and get a researched briefing with post ideas whenever you run it (saved as private notes), make a book you want to read - a researched table of contents first, each chapter written when you open it - see what to write next, and keep your writing style in one note. Drafts stay private until you say publish.
